target.name: Shopify
target.description: Shopify theme adapter using Liquid templates, generated token wrapper, copied CSS assets, and shared progressive-enhancement JavaScript.

policy.tokenOwnership: tokens.css is generated from platforms/web/tokens.css and should not be edited directly.
policy.baseOwnership: base.css is generated from reset, foundations, and utilities source CSS; it must not define token values.
policy.componentCssOwnership: Component CSS assets are copied from components/css and should be regenerated from source.
policy.runtimeDelivery: runtime-loader.js imports only the progressive-enhancement modules matched by rendered Liquid; theme.js remains a compatibility and diagnostic aggregate.
policy.liquidOwnership: Liquid files are Shopify adapter source and may map Shopify objects/settings into component contracts.
policy.maturityOwnership: Shopify maturity is computed from contract status, CSS output, Liquid evidence, section/block schema, data mapping, template composition, editor-preview readiness, and behavior requirements. Class-level contracts do not require dedicated Liquid roots.
policy.distribution: Consumer Shopify themes copy and own the generated adapter files locally.

strategies.embedded-class-contract: Reusable CSS/anatomy contract applied inside any Liquid context; no dedicated Liquid root is required.
strategies.dedicated-liquid-template: Shopify-specific markup is expected but has not been detected yet.
strategies.section-adapter: Merchant-editable Shopify section with Liquid, schema/settings, data mapping, template composition, and editor preview support.
strategies.theme-block-adapter: Future merchant-editable Shopify theme block with its own Liquid and schema.
strategies.snippet-adapter: Reusable Liquid snippet rendered by sections/templates with explicit data/render parameters.
strategies.layout-adapter: Shopify layout-level adapter for global shells and sections.

layers.css: Required for every component and satisfied by generated/copied Shopify CSS assets.
layers.liquid: Required for dedicated Shopify adapters; embedded class contracts may be implemented without a detected Liquid root.
layers.schema: Required for section and theme-block adapters; validates that target-native editor settings exist in Liquid schema.
layers.data: Required for dedicated Shopify adapters; tracks Shopify objects, settings, render calls, section calls, and snippet render parameters.
layers.behavior: Required when the contract defines behavior; accepted only when the Shopify adapter status is implemented.
layers.templateComposition: Required for section adapters; satisfied by JSON templates, layout section calls, or addable section presets.
layers.editorPreview: Required for section and theme-block adapters; checks that schema controls are wired into rendered Liquid instead of becoming dead editor controls.

contractAdapter.notes: Shopify Liquid can render native button or anchor elements with the same class contract.
Shopify Liquid can render labels, native input elements, form attributes, and validation messages with the same class contract.
Shopify renders native select markup and the shared theme.js progressively enhances it without changing submitted values.
Shopify Liquid renders native textarea elements, form attributes, and the input__field/textarea__field class composition.
Shopify renders native checkbox markup and the shared theme.js progressively initializes mixed state.
Shopify Liquid can render native named radio groups with the same class contract.
Shopify Liquid can render product, order, inventory, or marketing badges with the same class contract.
Shopify may use a named button for client-owned filters or a target-native link when removal is navigation.
Dedicated Liquid maps product money filters, localized labels, native compare-at semantics, and Shopify's unit-price measurement filter.
Shopify Liquid can render the quantity control and target JavaScript should synchronize cart quantity changes.
Dedicated Liquid maps Shopify Rating metadata and localized count text without owning aggregation or review-provider policy.
Embedded class contract uses generated canonical CSS; consuming Liquid owns asynchronous data, dimensions, region semantics, replacement, and errors.
Dedicated snippet maps icon, title, message, and Link action and requires a validated target-supplied heading_tag. Main cart and 404 use H1; the cart drawer uses H3 under its H2 dialog title.

Testimonials embeds the generated class around a Shopify image object and visible adjacent author name. Shopify remains responsible for choosing image or pre-derived initials; neutral Avatar owns no loading/error lifecycle.
Shopify Liquid can render semantic containers with card classes.
Shopify Liquid can render modal structure while theme JavaScript controls visibility and focus behavior.
Shopify Liquid can render drawer structure while theme JavaScript controls visibility and focus behavior.
Use Shopify host Tooltip/interestFor where available; theme targets may emit the neutral DOM relationship and target behavior.
Liquid can emit APG Button markup or native details; theme behavior owns optional group coordination.
Map to Shopify host Tabs value/defaultValue/change/controls/id when available; theme targets implement the neutral behavior.
The Shopify snippet renders the same nav, ordered-list, item, link, separator, and current-page class contract.
Liquid maps brand, menu, actions, and cart data, but shared search/cart/mobile runtime and action priority remain target work.
The existing Theme section maps merchant rich text to the canonical static mode. Countdown, rotation and controlled dismissal remain explicit target maturity work rather than copied behavior.
Current Liquid maps brand copy and menu blocks, but modern section-group placement remains an owner-level target decision; newsletter, locale, social, and legal composition are not inferred.
Current Liquid maps first-level Shopify navigation, while the missing Drawer lifecycle and any nested-menu policy remain target work.
Liquid can expose the semantic form and result container, but predictive-search service, truthful status, focus containment, Escape, inertness, and restoration still require target runtime.

Liquid maps cart records into canonical Cart Line Item plus localized summary and checkout. Production Drawer lifecycle, mutation/section refresh, pending/error/status, and editor/store proof remain required.
The product-card snippet maps Shopify product data to canonical Card, Badge, Button, Price, media, title-link, clamped description, and a target-coordination Quick Look hook.

Maps product.media image/video/external_video/model with native filters, deferred explicit activation, media badges, eligible Shopify XR action, controlled current-id event surface, and imageDetail none/lightbox.

Dedicated Liquid accepts product-level or exact selected-variant projection. Merchant-reorderable Main Product blocks and one Section Rendering API coordinator update media, Price, SKU, inventory, availability, form, URL, structured data, and one status without serializing the variant catalogue.

Liquid distinguishes exact sold-out variants from nonexistent combinations, preserves native swatches and granular option ids, and one target coordinator performs high-variant Section Rendering, Combined Listing product_url navigation, bounded dependent updates, focus restoration, URL synchronization and one status.

The Liquid product form is a complete native baseline. One target coordinator atomically refreshes merchandise id, quantity rules and submit availability; the merchant may show or omit Quantity. Optional Ajax may later intercept this same form but is not required for correctness.

The related-products section loads Product Recommendations through Section Rendering, composes canonical Product Card snippets, localizes controls, omits empty results, and owns bounded target scrolling.
The collection-template section maps native collection data, merchant-visible optional parts, image alt semantics, localized count copy, and image-derived presentation.
The collection page section paginates collection.products, maps the wide column setting, and renders one canonical Product Card snippet per native list item.

Main Collection maps collection.filters names, values, counts and active-removal URLs into the same GET form and adaptive surface; native navigation preserves linkable query state while enhanced section refresh remains target-owned.
main-collection.liquid maps Shopify paginate parts, native URLs, localized labels, current state, ellipses, and boundary omission to the canonical anatomy.
Dedicated merchant-configurable Liquid section maps image, identity, biography, quotation and one canonical Button destination without neutral runtime.
Dedicated merchant-configurable Liquid section maps ordered blocks, optional image/description content, editor attributes, localized labels and native overflow without target runtime.

Liquid snippet maps current product/metafield facts into localized semantic details and accepts optional explicit target-owned signature and verification inputs without generating a QR or authenticity claim.
Dedicated merchant-configurable Liquid section maps optional image metadata, label, required narrative fields, quotation, native Button action and visual reversal without neutral runtime.
A localized section maps ordered artwork blocks to passive native list and figure markup without assuming activation.
The canonical Hero section maps editor settings and slide blocks to the same contract and shared runtime.
Localized customer form uses canonical Input/Button markup, unique ids, platform field names, server error association, confirmed success, merchant content settings, and zero Newsletter JavaScript.

Merchant section maps valid blocks to the canonical native quotation anatomy with optional heading, editor attributes, target-native image delivery, localized schema metadata, and zero component runtime.
The public Coming Soon section maps target settings and a customer form; the independent password template is outside this contract.
Shopify Liquid can render ordered passive steps with the same class contract while the owning workflow controls navigation, validation, and announcements.
Liquid owns the finite collection while target JavaScript synchronizes native scroll state and uses the shared Icon Button class contract.
Shopify Liquid renders the same native overflow class contract and supplies role, tabindex, and accessible naming only when its content requires direct keyboard scrolling.
Product Gallery Liquid composes canonical Lightbox over its image subset with stable-id synchronization, focus lifecycle, finite/loop navigation, swipe, bounded zoom/pan, and localized controls.
Shopify Liquid can render native checkbox switches with the same class contract.
Shopify product option swatches can render the same class contract.
Requires one concrete Shopify data owner and target-native serialization/update policy; canonical copied CSS and Tag composition are available.
Shopify Liquid can render radio-backed segmented controls with the same class contract.
Shopify Liquid can render field wrappers with labels, native controls, and messages using the same class contract.
Shopify Liquid can render native fieldset groups with the same class contract.
Shopify Liquid can render validation messages with matching ids and form control references.
Shopify Liquid can render native forms, field wrappers, buttons, and error summaries with this class contract.
Compose canonical Popover or Modal according to campaign semantics; G4 owns no Shopify adapter.
Merchant section maps non-empty statement blocks to canonical native list anatomy, optional decorative target images, localized schema metadata, strict empty omission, and no component runtime.

Dedicated snippet consumes supplied types or shop.enabled_payment_types and maps official payment_type_svg_tag output to the canonical native-list class contract with a localized list label and zero component JavaScript.
Canonical CSS/runtime are copied, but a target-native merchant data surface and truthful placement remain intentionally unselected.

A target adapter is deferred until that target documents and proves the ADR 0252 authoritative source, claim qualification, selected-variant/market scope where applicable, refresh/expiry, privacy, placement, and stale/error omission behavior.
A future target adapter must project Shopify Customer Privacy state and mutations into this contract; copied CSS is not provider readiness.

ADR 0253 omits G10 from Shopify v1 until a verified provider or authoritative source and its event qualification, freshness/expiry, privacy, placement, queue/timing, persistence, withdrawal, and focus policy are selected and certified.
Use canonical C2 Announcement Bar; G11 owns no Shopify adapter.

Main Cart maps Shopify cart items, localized count, canonical summary, configurable flow/sticky placement, native update form, checkout, note and real continue destination into the composition. The target maps its Header offset and responsive fallback; server-authoritative mutations, empty transition, editor behavior, accelerated checkout and live-store proof remain required.
Liquid maps cart line keys, localized product detail and money, native update/removal form semantics, and optional Ajax/section refresh; runtime mutation evidence remains target-owned.
Dedicated Liquid maps cart facts, named checkout submission and optional provider-owned accelerated checkout; runtime/editor/live-store proof remains required.
Dedicated Liquid maps localized composition to standard storefront discount actions; runtime/editor/live-store proof remains required.
Parameter-driven translation only; merchant/product policy must choose qualifying amount, threshold, placement, refresh, message, and announcement behavior.
Recommendation source, cart placement, product-recommendation request context, variant/add policy, merchant settings, refresh, tracking, status, and editor proof remain open target decisions.

Dedicated Cart Empty snippet forwards required host heading_tag into canonical Empty State. Main cart selects H1 from Shopify cart truth with localized copy and `routes.all_products_collection_url`; live Ajax/drawer transition evidence remains target work.

The product-context snippet maps complete product.media through canonical Product Gallery with image_detail none plus canonical Price/Form/Link. Invocation, complete-snapshot loading, variant synchronization, purchase lifecycle, focus/status and live-theme proof remain target work.

Product-context Liquid may associate the external Button with the main product form, but a real Main Product consumer must still prove live option/quantity coordination, eligibility observation, Ajax/native purchase outcomes, feedback, focus, safe-area/collision handling and editor behavior.
Optional editor-enabled cart-page snippet maps one canonical Textarea to cart.note and textarea[name=note] inside the native cart form; Ajax cart-drawer persistence remains target work.

A target-native snippet, global dedicated single-variant product setting, and Ajax coordinator implement the accepted sellable-line candidate. Live merchant configuration, eligibility, Cart Page/Drawer refresh, inventory/tax/fulfillment policy, errors, focus, and editor proof remain required before target readiness.

Shopify v1 delegates authentication to the current hosted authorization/account experience and authenticated Customer Account API or extension profile; it does not render a theme-owned U1 credential form. Classic Liquid requires a separately versioned compatibility adapter. Live handoff or headless proof remains required before target readiness.

Shopify v1 current customer accounts are passwordless and intentionally omit U2. Classic recover_customer_password and the distinct reset_customer_password step require a separately versioned compatibility adapter; no automatic fallback is allowed.

Shopify v1 themes use the controlled shopify-account sheet and hosted pages as an intentional native handoff with no parity claim. Target-controlled full-page extensions or headless storefronts may project U3 semantics with native components and Customer Account data. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not a universal dashboard.

Shopify v1 themes use the hosted current-account Order index as an intentional native handoff with no U4 parity claim. Target-controlled full-page extensions or headless storefronts may project authoritative U4 summaries with native components and Customer Account data. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not a universal order-history implementation.

Shopify v1 uses the hosted current-account Order status page as an intentional native handoff with no U5 parity claim. Target-controlled extensions or headless storefronts may project authoritative U5 metadata, provider-trusted Steps and read-only purchase lines. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not target readiness.

Shopify v1 uses hosted Profile/Addresses as an intentional native handoff with no U6 parity claim. Target-controlled supplementary/full-page extensions or headless storefronts may project authoritative records and protected mutations with target-native components and Customer Account data, including B2B policy. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not readiness.

Shopify v1 uses hosted current-account Profile/Addresses as an intentional native handoff with no U7 parity claim. Target-controlled headless storefronts may project canonical U7 against authenticated Customer Account address mutations and field-addressable user errors. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not readiness.

The selected profile combines a local-device storefront wishlist with an authenticated account service and idempotent exact-variant union after sign-in. Shopify documents Wishlist as a customer-account.page.render full-page extension; any customer metafield writes require appropriate scopes and approved protected-customer-data access. Copied theme CSS is not readiness.

Map each section separately to a supported customer-account profile/block/full-page extension, authenticated service, policy-backed consent mutation, hosted setting link, or omission. Current Shopify Switch is for immediate effects and explicitly recommends Checkbox for values requiring submission. Copied theme CSS is not target-native readiness.

The article-card snippet maps Shopify article title, URL, image, published timestamp, excerpt, author, explicit display flags, heading rank, layout, Card surface, excerpt lines, and optional passed blog label without inferred reading time or JavaScript.

The article-hero snippet maps Shopify article title, image, author, and published timestamp with explicit variant, heading, label, visibility, alt-policy, sizes, and loading inputs; it adds no inferred duration, taxonomy, JavaScript, or structured data.

The passive article-body snippet maps trusted supplied content or article.content to article-body prose without parsing or rewriting. Sections/templates own sanitization, breakouts, commerce islands, locale, SEO, editor behavior, and canonical child snippets.
Requires a selected article/template owner, explicit source association and Theme Editor lifecycle before Automatic is target-ready; Controlled remains available to a target service.

Expose L5 only when the article source supplies structured heading records and matching unique ids or verified preprocessing emits both atomically. Arbitrary merchant HTML is never parsed by neutral L5; the first article owner must map placement and any shared reading-state integration.

A passive snippet maps explicit user or article.user data, requires a name, omits unavailable parts and keeps homepage/email off until explicitly enabled with localized labels. First consumer, contextual placement, privacy approval, role/social extensions and multiple authors remain target-owned.
Compose canonical controls from target filter records and synchronize the chosen query parameter plus section results; no neutral query key or Shopify filter schema is frozen.

A reusable snippet maps an explicit Shopify blog to Recent Articles and Topics Link lists with host-supplied label, headings, rank, order switches and limits. Search and Newsletter remain separate compositions; first template placement and editor exposure remain target-owned.
A future storefront/app consumer selects valid actions, canonical resource data, localized labels, verified provider mappings and progressive native/copy feedback; copied CSS alone is not readiness.

A Theme Editor section maps Shopify's ordered article_list setting with limit three into canonical Article Cards, excludes the current article and duplicates, omits empty output, and exposes only contextual heading plus canonical child-card presentation settings. Article-template placement remains host-owned.

Article-only Theme Editor section maps published article.comments, canonical finite Pagination, canonical Empty State and the native new_comment form with exact author/email/body names, localization and moderation/result feedback. Shopify remains flat and deliberately omits replies and reactions.
Use the canonical G1 Hero section; S1 owns no Shopify adapter.
Merchant-editable section maps a selected collection, title, presentation, bounded target product count, derived view-all Link, and canonical Product Card snippet.
Merchant-editable section maps responsive image data, decorative classification, required heading/rich text, optional eyebrow/complete button pair, and five presentation choices.
Merchant-editable section maps an optional contextual title and reorderable native-list item blocks with explicit passive-media semantics and no component runtime.
Merchant-editable section maps optional title/variant and reorderable image blocks with explicit passive media semantics and no component runtime.

Localized merchant section maps valid ordered blocks to native details/summary with canonical Accordion classes, theme-editor attributes and no target script.
Localized merchant section uses Shopify's contact form tag, platform field names, server errors, confirmed success, canonical classes, and zero S10 JavaScript.
Merchant-editable section maps an optional contextual title and reorderable metric blocks to canonical Stat classes with editor attributes and no component runtime.
Map ordered image/link blocks, explicit alternative text and static/marquee settings to the same source semantics; editor-preview runtime remains target certification work.

Merchant-editable section maps reorderable labelled fact blocks, optional supporting text, optional decorative images, strict omission, editor attributes, and zero component runtime.

Requires approved record source, editor schema, passive versus selectable use, product-option mapping, claim policy, ordering/limits, localization, and first template consumer.

Requires approved product data source, content authority, safety/legal review, section/block schema, limits/order, localization, symbol policy, and first template consumer.

Requires approved normalized schedule/observation records, validation, provenance, safety/editor rules and a first consumer before Liquid/schema.

Requires approved commission fields, consent, contact or app endpoint, Liquid form mapping, result behavior, and a verified file-upload service if references are required.
Select an approved maker source and product relationship before mapping product.vendor, metafields, metaobjects, stamp media, localization, editor validation, or authenticity claims.
Liquid should map menu/linklist and promo/featured blocks while target JavaScript owns the external Button lifecycle, route state, dismissal, and mobile substitution.
Liquid should map a merchant menu and current route while target services synchronize cart/customer counts, page-shell offset, and visibility.

Main Product can render size-chart.liquid from product.metafields.custom.size_chart. A bounded merchant-owned metaobject supplies one required and one optional complete three-column table, localized notes and at most twenty valid rows per presentation; size-chart.js maps canonical behavior to native dialog modality without conversion.

Main Product hosts provider app blocks, publishes current variant and market context, replaces the app block with every variant render and emits both identities. The installed app owns registration, consent, inventory observation and delivery; the theme ships no notification database or fake endpoint.

Shopify can map selected-variant store availability, but search/geocoding, intent persistence, exact market/product coordinator integration, cart/checkout confirmation, localization, editor, and live-store proof remain required.

Requires a target-native general-location data source, search/geocoding, localization, optional map provider, directions policy, schema/editor behavior, and live-store proof; product store availability is not a general locator source.

Shopify can map variant sellingPlanAllocations to recurring records and one-time to an empty selling_plan payload, but target-native Liquid/block composition, one coordinator, localization, editor behavior and live-store proof remain required.
Requires an owning collection section, visible localized labels, result-mode mapping, merchant/default policy, optional URL/persistence coordination, editor behavior, and live-store proof.

E6-A requires an explicit collection-grid block or record whose owning section preserves product order, pagination and counts and supplies schema, localization, data mapping, editor preview and live-store evidence.

Under E7-A the owning Shopify collection section must distinguish source-inventory empty from filtered/search zero, supply truthful localized content and recovery, and prove atomic filter/Grid/Pagination replacement, URL/history, focus, status and section-refresh behavior.
Generated CSS is available; target-native artist records and filtering require an accepted artist data, result, and URL model.

Generated CSS and canonical Badge class are available; dedicated Liquid, artist data, destination, responsive portrait markup and merchant schema await target decisions. No component JavaScript is required by the neutral contract.
Generated CSS is available; exhibition template, sections/blocks, schema, data, editor behavior, responsive media and record ownership remain planned.
A localized merchant-configurable Liquid section maps portrait intent, editorial identity, quotation, rich body and optional text/image signature without neutral runtime or authenticity claims.

Copied CSS is target-ready, but a future Liquid projection must select a truthful review provider or data model, locale labels, scale and distribution without adding neutral JavaScript or changing this passive display contract.
Use the existing canonical Rating Liquid projection; V2 owns no Shopify adapter.
Submission transport and provider mapping remain outside the Star Input contract.

Official Shopify guidance assigns product reviews to dynamic-source app blocks. A future provider adapter supplies truthful data, localization, actions and persistence while consuming generated Gallery CSS.
A future review-provider theme app block supplies taxonomy, localized counts and any URLs/actions while consuming generated Gallery CSS; no provider-free Liquid is implied.
A review-provider theme app block must supply moderated images, Shopify CDN transforms, localized alternatives and any action/overlay composition while consuming generated CSS.
A future adapter must select a review provider, form endpoint, file policy, and submission workflow.
A future provider theme app block must supply allowed controls, result lifecycle and write-review behavior while consuming generated CSS.
A selected review-provider app block may map its finite page model to canonical Pagination; no provider-neutral review Liquid is authorized.
Maps localized optional heading and paired account/action links plus validated merchant image blocks to canonical classes with strict empty omission and zero component JavaScript.
Map ordered blocks and semantic settings to the same static baseline and storefront enhancement; editor preview remains static until target implementation is certified.
Target-native localized image-block section with strict omission and zero JavaScript.
Liquid maps records and groups to canonical Accordion markup or a semantics-preserving details/summary equivalent; the target owns ids and group policy.
Can compose ordered Process Timeline blocks plus optional editorial settings/media after merchant record schema and media policy are selected; no generic Liquid player is authorized.
Liquid maps merchant records to canonical Accordion markup or a semantics-preserving details/summary equivalent; the target owns ids, expansion policy, records, and destinations.
Existing JSON 404 template maps target-owned response, routes and search into canonical P1 and dependency classes; ADR 0236 maps the standalone page heading to H1 through canonical Empty State.
Dedicated gift_card.liquid maps Shopify balance, state, expiration, code, QR identifier, pass URL, issuer and target copy/print behavior.
A strict reusable snippet maps one supplied Liquid policy object's title/body to canonical P3 anatomy and truthfully omits date/index data absent from the platform object.
Native checkout requires an approved Checkout UI Extension target and supported Shopify components/data. Theme Liquid cannot own or copy this neutral checkout DOM/CSS.
